theme: Peak-season weekend demand on the Dal - boats booking up first
season: Peak summer (late June 2026) - Srinagar 22-32C by day and cool at dusk, Pahalgam and Sonamarg in the high teens to low twenties, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel open, gardens in full colour and the Dal glass-still at dawn - the warm, easy window before the early-July Amarnath rush.
subject: This weekend's lake guest booked another deck
